# IELTS Imperia

> IELTS Imperia (ieltsimperia.uz) is a premium IELTS, SAT and English academy in Urgench, Uzbekistan, founded in 2016 by Khushnud Rustamovich. Motto: "Your result is my reputation."

## Why students choose IELTS Imperia
- Teaching since 2016, led personally by founder and head teacher Khushnud Rustamovich.
- Real computer-based IELTS mock tests that copy the official exam format.
- Computer-based grammar tests and interactive, engaging lessons.
- Lessons explained in Uzbek or Russian.
- Cash reward program by contract: band 7.5 = $50, 8.0 = $100, 8.5 = $150, 9.0 = $300. At least 70% of graduates earn a reward.
- Premium equipped learning center.

## Courses
- IELTS (general preparation)
- Individual IELTS (one-to-one)
- IELTS 8+ (high-band preparation)
- Kids English (from age 8)
- SAT
- English Grammar
